source_url: REPLACE: the official https link of the source of these rules
source_checked_on: REPLACE: YYYY-MM-DD, the day you compared this file with that link

rules.title: REPLACE: a short title for the rule
rules.starts_from: REPLACE: what the period starts from, in words

period.unit: REPLACE: days, weeks, months or years

rules.month_end: REPLACE (only when the period is in months or years): last_day_of_month or first_day_of_next_month
rules.calendar_court: REPLACE (only when when_not_working moves the date): the court whose calendar to use
rules.calendar_year: REPLACE: the year of that calendar, as a number
authorities: REPLACE: the provision or rule this comes from, as the source writes it
not_applied: REPLACE (optional): a condition under which this rule does not apply
